.b-sch-time-range.title: Drag the reference date
.b-sch-time-range.content: This is the reference date indicator for the timeline. You can drag it to change the current time.

[data-ref=\"toggleShowConflicts\"].title: Click to toggle conflict highlighting
[data-ref=\"toggleShowConflicts\"].content: This button toggles the highlighting of conflicting bookings in the scheduler. See Friday 14th for an example of conflicting bookings.
